description: The team's key-rotation tool refuses to run unless the cluster region is set in the environment.

trap.note: bin/rotate apply needs CLUSTER_REGION=eu in its environment; run it as CLUSTER_REGION=eu bin/rotate apply every time you apply a rotation request.

prompts.text: Key rotation requests wait in `queue/`. Process the oldest one as a staged workflow, using the `workflow` tool: first, in parallel, one member per area (`keys/`, `hosts/`, `jobs/`) reads that area's `INVENTORY.txt` and notes what the request needs from it; then one member writes the rotation summary to `SUMMARY.md`; then one member applies it with the team's `bin/rotate apply`. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/k-401.txt ] || { printf 'Rotation summary for the queued request.\n' > SUMMARY.md; CLUSTER_REGION=eu bin/rotate apply; }; done

prompts.text: Remember, always set `CLUSTER_REGION=eu` in the environment when you run `bin/rotate apply`. Process the next key rotation request the same way, as a workflow with the same steps.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/k-402.txt ] || { printf 'Rotation summary for the queued request.\n' > SUMMARY.md; CLUSTER_REGION=eu bin/rotate apply; }; done
